scoring_justification: The agent produces only the final computed slope; there is no intermediate artifact from which the slope could be recomputed independently. The hidden checker compares the reported slope to the paper's simulated value using an exact-match tolerance.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text, Section 7, Figure 12 caption: '-13.22 pm mW^{-1} simulated using equation (17)'.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The value is the paper's own reported simulated slope.

schema.description: single numeric value (no header), units pm/mW

outputs.description: Steady-state Bragg wavelength shift per unit input electrical power predicted by the 1D thermal model.

output_contract.notes: The model uses the material and geometric parameters from the paper; the agent must implement the calculation. No additional outputs are required.

steps.description: Compare computed slope to paper's simulated value of -13.22 pm/mW.
